rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun phrase for an impossible thing or proposal.

example.english: This plan is simply an impossibility, so stop wasting time.
example.traditional: 呢個計劃根本係冇可能嘅事，唔好再嘥時間喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 gan1 bun2 hai6 mou5 ho2 nang4 ge3 si6 m4 hou2 zoi3 saai1 si4 gaan1 laa3

rows.jyutping: A ge3 ho2 nang4 sing3 hai6 ling4
rows.note: Use this for the abstract state that an outcome has no possibility of occurring, rather than for an impossible thing itself.

example.english: The impossibility of this outcome is obvious.
example.traditional: 呢個結果出現嘅可能性係零。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 git3 gwo2 ceot1 jin6 ge3 ho2 nang4 sing3 hai6 ling4
